title: Moving Slowly (wet clothes, muscles aren’t working, trudging through mud)
content: Hi guys Mikku here. We all have dreams of trying to run, but we can’t move, or we are moving very slowly. There is something chasing us, and the closer it gets, the slower we move. This is a classic nightmare. We feel as if something or someone is approaching us with a negative intention. We try to run and we get stuck. Often this dream ends in death, or simply waking up before we get caught. How does this relate to mallworld? I’ve seen people discuss the idea that there are MallWorld “moderators” and “creators”. Some governing body of entities that creates and maintains MallWorld. What do you guys think? Is someone slowing us down intentionally? Do we need to get caught? Or can we learn to speed up, and break through the code holding us in slow motion? Same thing with flying in dreams. I’ve only been able to fly two times in dreams, and it’s the best feeling ever, but I’ve tried countless times, and it almost never works. As a frequent lucid dreamer, I can usually control many aspects of my dreams, but speed and flying tend to be somewhat restricted or I’ll just wake up if I try. Anyone else have these issues?
